plan.counts_def: Denominator is each surviving eligible coordinate update, reported separately for weights and biases. continuous_change means the fp32 .02 proposal differs from the previous decoded value. outside_range counts the unclipped proposal beyond the birth radius. at_range counts resulting endpoint codes/values. stored_change counts actual word changes. Static proposes no change.
plan.decision: Report pooled equal-age and per-age paired 95% crossed intervals for A/B/X and all three. Compare each mode against FP32 and static 4 bits. Primary behavior equivalence to FP32 requires X and all-three paired intervals fully within ±2pp in both cohorts on pooled absent-A worlds. The swap's direct A and native A after X are primary memory diagnostics, with B/X as specificity controls.
plan.packed_snapshot: Actual bytes for one world-0 lane before the final X fork: reference words, 20 little-endian fp32 row radii, then packed 400-bit continuous-survival mask. The ordinary live graph and transient decode memory are additional.
plan.protocol: Four physical studies of each A and B, then 16/64/128 intervening contacts. Main worlds omit A; secondary worlds allow A to recur. B timing matches. Each probe starts from the same post-X state. Heldout geometry and all four A/B laws and two X laws cross. Physical choices and edits retain native fp32 throughout.
plan.range: All five reference variants share the same fixed per-receiver max-absolute birth radius including bias, the same continuously surviving original nonzero address mask, and always-eligible biases. FP32 proposals also clip to that row interval. After each native write, the fast graph receives .12 interpolation toward the prior reference and exact post-write ticks. Mutable references then move .02 toward this corrected fast graph, clip, and store only the new reference words. Static beta is zero.
plan.stochastic: Independently keyed uniform per address and contact, repeated across matched law branches of the same geometry. Stochastically choose adjacent codes by fractional distance, unbiased conditional on the clipped proposal. No residual or fp32 shadow is carried. The external evaluation random stream is separate from payload bytes.
plan.swap: At each age, transplant common-surviving numeric reference coordinates and bias from the opposite-A matched world sharing geometry and B law. Recipient live graph, activity, traces and ancestry stay in place. Compare a reference-only graph read and behavior after one matched actual X contact. The X choice and taste are asserted equal between swap branches. Own minus opposite A correctness is the label-specific readout.
